product_metadata.title: DII Lattice Basics Collection Kitchen Essentials, Pan Handle Set, Gray, 3, Piece
features: WARNING & USE: Use up to 400 degrees Fahrenheit only, do not use or place near open flame, do not leave inside oven. Pan handle should not be left on stove top. Remove from handle when not lifting, moving, or holding onto pan.
EASY CARE LONG-LASTING MATERIAL: 100% Cotton Fabric, Machine Washable. Wash with Cold Water in Gentle Cycle & Tumble Dry Low. Do not bleach them or run them through a hot dryer
PROTECT YOUR HANDS FROM HEAT: Heat resistant allowing you to safely hold or remove hot pots from the stove and oven
GREAT GIFT CHOICE WITH MANY COLORS: These easy care handle holders come with multiple colors, perfect for Mother's day, birthday, holidays, housewarming and hostess gifts.

MORE DII KITCHEN POT HOLDERS OPTIONS - DII offers delightful Kitchen Linens including dishtowels, dish cloths, aprons, potholders and oven mitts, but for more options search: DII Pan Handle or click the DII link at the top of the page to explore our other collection.
description: Get a Colorful and Functional Kitchen Accessory With DII Lattice Pan Handle Covers DII has built these pretty and well-made Pan Handle sets for you to make an adorable kitchen. Perfect for cooking, baking, serving, or dinner party. These basic Pan Handles are a great value on any budget, great gift choice for housewarming, college dorms, new apartments, Mother's day, birthdays, wedding shower or holidays. DII Lattice Pot Holders coordinate well with our Lattice oven mitts and pan handles to coordinate in your kitchen. Simply search DII Pot Holders and you'll find a cohesive collection. Own them right now! Everyday Kitchen Essentials DII 100% cotton, machine Washable 3-piece Pan Handle Cover set, each measures 6x3", offer full protection for your hand when handling hot pots and pans in your kitchen. DII Lattice Pot Holder Set is a must-have everyday kitchen tool, come with multiple beautiful colors for you to choose from. Quality you can rely on. DII Pan Handle Cover Sets are made of durable and comfortable 100% Cotton, quilted to offer durability and flexibility for a better grip on hot pots. Designed with your safety in mind and to shield hands from heat when cooking and handling hot pots and pans. These kitchen linen sets are heat resistant, protect your hands while handling hot pots, pans, dishes, casserole dishes and more. Washing and Care Instructions: ToWash, Use Cold water, Color Separated; DO NOT use bleach; Do not use fabric softener; Dry in Tumble cycle to minimize shrinkage. May be ironed with low heat.
